newsitem.title: USA: ACE*COMM SEES Q4 REVS $11.1 MLN.
newsitem.headline: ACE*COMM SEES Q4 REVS $11.1 MLN.

text.p: ACE*COMM Corp said Wednesday it expects its fiscal fourth revenues, excluding revenues related to certain software license contracts, to be about $11.1 million, up 64 percent from the year ago period.
ACE*COMM, which provides operations support systems for telecommunication networks, expects its full year revenues to increase 62 percent to $32.8 million.

These estimates exclude revenues relating to a certain contracts, which are the subject of discussions with the company's auditors to determine the appropriate period in which to recognize such revenues, under current accounting principles, ACE*COMM said.

The absence of such revenues may have an adverse effect on the company's income and earnings per share for the reported periods due to the higher relative margins associated with such revenue, ACE*COMM said.
However, revenues that are not recognized in the fourth quarter are expected to be recognized in a subsequent period, the company said.
Analysts expect ACE*COMM to post fourth quarter earnings of $0.11 a share and full year earnings of $0.31 a share, according to First Call.

ACE*COMM, which was supposed to report its quarterly results on August 12, has rescheduled its fourth quarter conference call until August 19, to accommodate delays in finalizing its year end audit. At that time, ACE*COMM will report comprehensive results for the quarter and fiscal year.
"ACE*COMM's business fundamentals remain very strong and are in no way affected by the accounting changes," said George Jimenez, ACE*COMM's president chief executive officer.
